surprise.detail: Unlike gong/notion (which entered this sweep already near full documented-operation parity from an earlier dedicated build program and needed only a small top-off), mixpanel's existing bundle is a read-only, 10-stream legacy-Query-API connector with capabilities.write=false and NO cli_surface.json/operations.json/writes.json at all. Reaching 104 documented operations requires a first-time full build of reverse-ETL writes, new direct-read-shaped streams, and CLI reachability across 13 admin/ingestion domains (annotations, experiments, feature flags, feature-flag management, GDPR, identity, ingestion, lexicon schemas, query, service accounts, warehouse connectors, data pipelines), not a small increment. A second, engine-level surprise: internal/connectors/engine's operations.json-backed direct_read/direct_write/binary_download executors require a connector-relative path resolved against the ONE configured base_url (isAbsoluteHTTPURL is rejected for those three executors), but mixpanel's 13 documented files span 5 distinct real hosts (mixpanel.com/api/2.0, mixpanel.com/api/app, mixpanel.com/api/query, data.mixpanel.com/api/2.0, api.mixpanel.com). streams.json and writes.json, by contrast, both already support fully-qualified absolute-URL paths bypassing base_url (proven by 7 of the existing 10 streams and by youtube-analytics' writes.json). Resolution: every new read/write is implemented as a stream (intent=etl) or write action (intent=reverse_etl) with an explicit absolute URL for its real host, matching established precedent already in this exact bundle; operations.json is not introduced. POST /nessie/pipeline/create and POST /nessie/pipeline/edit (data-pipelines.yaml) are oneOf/discriminator-rooted request bodies (up to 8 alternate arms) with no single fixed body_schema, matching the AGENTS.md rule that such operations must be modeled as separate named actions or left non-implemented; left non-implemented (blocked) rather than arbitrarily picking one arm. GET /export lives on data.mixpanel.com (a different host than the chosen base_url) and returns NDJSON, not a single JSON document, so neither streams.json's schema-projection reader nor the connector-relative binary_download executor fits; blocked. POST /jql executes caller-supplied JavaScript, which is the query-API equivalent of the generic script/SQL-write tools AGENTS.md forbids; blocked.
